name: RavenPack News Analytics (category-split sentiment)
crowding: rp_css_ratings ac=380 (crowded); mean_* fields ac=0-31 (moderate); several ac=0 fields available
stage1_verdict: VIRGIN — zero prior backtest consumption. Highest alpha_max (380) among all virgin news datasets → highest Sharpe ceiling candidate.

rp_css_group_cov0.5: composite sentiment by category (assets, business, credit, ..., ratings, revenue, ...)

design_notes: All mean_* fields coverage=1.0 → no vec_* needed, no tied-zeros, safe for direct use.
Sentiment scores presumed bounded [0,1] or [-1,1] → de-center via subtract(x,0.5) before multiply/divide (Axiom 1).
ts_rank is shift-invariant → safe on raw bounded fields.
rp_* fields coverage=0.5 → wrap with ts_backfill(x,120) before use (avoid CONCENTRATED_WEIGHT).
Multiplicative weights strictly positive: rank() only. No multiply of two signed variables.
No group_rank output layer; no external close/returns/volume.
Cross-category structure (css/ess/nip × 10 categories) enables interaction signals unavailable in news83/news59.
